A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ReSim research work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures and complete appendices A–E are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original prediction, controllability, reward estimation and planning experiments, a human preference study, and qualitative ablations and failure cases.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Tables 1–4, the main-text figures and Appendix C, including the human study documented in Appendix B.4.

M1.justification: The CogVideoX-based architecture, conditioning, dynamics consistency loss, noise sampling, three-stage training, Video2Reward and inverse dynamics model remain unchanged. Appendix B.1 elaborates existing data collection rather than introducing a revised method.

E1.justification: Training and evaluation retain OpenDV, NAVSIM, CARLA, Waymo and nuScenes with the same tasks. The newly specified CARLA maneuvers explain existing collection; correcting 'OpenCV datasets' to 'OpenDV datasets' does not indicate a different dataset.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in each corresponding experiment. This includes the video-generation baselines in Table 2, Transfuser/LTF and selection strategies in Table 3, and VO planner, UniAD, Transfuser, DrivingGPT and LAW in Table 4.

E3.justification: Splits, metrics, training budgets and evaluation procedures remain unchanged, including 540 Waymo samples, 300 policy-selection scenarios and the 600-answer human study. The additional CARLA collection instructions are newly disclosed details, not an explicitly changed protocol.

E4.justification: Section 3.3 and Appendix C retain the same simulated-data, noise-sampling and dynamics-loss ablations, alongside the same long-horizon comparisons and failure examples. No analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or formal significance tests. Statistical reporting practices remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–4 retain all values, including ReSim's Waymo errors of 1.13/0.86, nuScenes FID/FVD of 5.2/50.4, and selection/planning PDMS of 74.1/86.6. Quantitative plots and qualitative results, including the appendix examples, also match.

T1.justification: The diffusion and dynamics-consistency loss definitions in Equations (1)–(2), their mathematical explanations and associated assumptions are unchanged. No theorem, proof or derivation is added.

C1.justification: Contribution (1) removes 'we are the first' and changes the assertion that combining data sources 'overcomes' the shortage of unsafe behaviors to 'can alleviate' it. This narrows one central contribution claim; the model, application and performance claims otherwise remain.

C2.justification: The substantive result interpretations and limitations in Sections 3–4 and Appendices C–D remain unchanged, including inference cost, front-view restrictions, hallucinations, visual artifacts and geographical bias. No new mechanism explanation or applicability boundary is introduced.

D1.justification: Appendix B.1 newly specifies one second of PDM-Lite driving followed by four seconds of exploration, named maneuvers and parameter randomization, beyond v1's generic rule-based sampling description. However, 'Slight Turns' and 'Hard Turns' receive identical 10–20-degree instructions, leaving that distinction unclear.

R1.justification: Removing the introduction's explicit priority claim modestly narrows novelty positioning. The same 124 references and related-work discussion remain; Appendix A.1 still retains a related 'for the first time' assertion.

P1.justification: Changes comprise localized abstract and contribution edits, the expanded data-collection paragraph, an added appendix cross-reference, the OpenDV typo correction, table-reference abbreviations, and author and acknowledgment updates. Overall section organization remains unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures and table structures retain their content. Figure 1's raster elements are downsampled, appendix reflow moves Figure S.12 from page 20 to page 21, and the title page adds a conference footer and corresponding-author markings.

improvement.justification: The added CARLA collection instructions in Appendix B.1 modestly improve reproducibility, while 'can alleviate' states the contribution more cautiously than 'overcomes.' These gains are limited: empirical evidence is unchanged, and the duplicated slight-turn/hard-turn descriptions leave part of the collection procedure ambiguous.
